This is my friend and co-worker Emma's apartment, and as soon as you walk in, you're greeted by a very skinny, very white apartment entryway... with just a few too many doors. She asked for shoe storage, a place to sit while putting on said shoes, a spot to drop her keys, and a mirror of any size, and some color, of course!
